card.name: Resuming infusion at reduced rate
card.fires_on: Small words right before a rate or dose number or grade, such as 'at', 'the' or a space, mainly when an infusion is resumed at a reduced rate. It also fires on the space before a grade or unit digit such as 'grade 3/4' or 'cells/mm 3'.

modes.label: Resume at reduced rate
modes.description: The word 'at' or 'the' after resume, restart or continue, ahead of a lower rate or dose.
modes.example: Resume the infusion at 50% of<< the>> infusion rate at which the reaction occurred.

modes.label: Space before a digit
modes.description: A space or number piece just before a grade, unit exponent or rate value in lab and dosing text.
modes.example: respiratory failure. Monitor patients for infusion-related reactions which can be severe. Interrupt the infusion for infusion reactions and institute appropriate medical management prior to continuing infusion at<< a>> slower rate.

card.writes: It suppresses words like action and activity, so it seems to steer the next word toward a number or grade.
card.plain: It marks the spot in infusion instructions where the text is about to give a slower rate or a grade number.
